standard.summary: 将单个 Transformer 层的计算切分到多个 GPU 上（Tensor Parallelism），或将序列维度切分到多个 GPU 上（Sequence Parallelism），支持超大模型单步训练。
standard.effect: tensor_parallel_degree 控制 TP 并行度（默认 1，即不切分）。sequence_parallel=True 启用序列并行。parallel_backend 选择通信后端（auto/nccl/gloo）。需要 torchrun 启动。
standard.whenToUse: 模型太大单卡放不下时（如 FLUX 全参微调）。与 DDP (multi_gpu) 不同——DDP 是数据并行，TP/SP 是模型并行。
standard.avoidWhen: 单卡能跑时不需要。TP/SP 通信开销大，需要高速 GPU 互联（NVLink）。

standard_en.summary: Splits a single Transformer layer's computation across several GPUs (tensor parallelism), or splits the sequence dimension across several GPUs (sequence parallelism), which makes single-step training of a very large model possible.
standard_en.effect: tensor_parallel_degree sets the TP degree (default 1, meaning no splitting). sequence_parallel=True enables sequence parallelism. parallel_backend chooses the communication backend (auto/nccl/gloo). It has to be launched with torchrun.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the model is too large for one card (a full FLUX finetune, say). Different from DDP (multi_gpu) -- DDP is data parallelism, TP/SP is model parallelism.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when one card can do the job. TP/SP carry heavy communication overhead and want a fast GPU interconnect (NVLink).

advanced.principle: Tensor Parallelism: 将每个 Linear 层的权重矩阵按列或行切分到多个 GPU 上，每个 GPU 只计算部分列/行，然后通过 all-reduce/all-gather 合并结果。Sequence Parallelism: 将序列维度切分，每个 GPU 处理部分 token，attention 需要 all-to-all 通信。parallel_backend 只能是 auto/nccl/gloo；历史上的 'cuda_direct' 不是后端而是一组 NCCL P2P/IPC 环境提示，只在张量并行这条路上被归一化，走 DDP 时会原样进 init_process_group 并报错，所以现在配置解析期就拒收。tensor_parallel_degree > 1 需要 torchrun 启动多进程。
advanced.intervention: 模型构建时将 Linear/Attention 层包装为 TP/SP 版本。
advanced.expectedImpact: 支持超大模型训练。通信效率取决于 GPU 互联带宽。
advanced.tradeoffs: TP 和 DDP 可以组合使用。SP 对 attention 有额外通信开销。
advanced.codePath: core/parallel/ → tensor parallel + sequence parallel layer wrapping

advanced_en.principle: Tensor Parallelism: splits each Linear layer's weight matrix by columns or rows across multiple GPUs, each GPU computing a partial column/row, then merging results via all-reduce/all-gather. Sequence Parallelism: splits the sequence dimension, each GPU handling a subset of tokens, with attention requiring all-to-all communication. parallel_backend can only be auto/nccl/gloo; the historical 'cuda_direct' is not a backend but a set of NCCL P2P/IPC environment hints, normalized only on the tensor-parallel path — on the DDP path it would enter init_process_group verbatim and error, so it is now rejected at config parse time. tensor_parallel_degree > 1 requires launching multiple processes with torchrun.
advanced_en.intervention: At model construction, Linear/Attention layers are wrapped in TP/SP versions.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Enables very large model training. Communication efficiency depends on GPU interconnect bandwidth.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: TP and DDP can be combined. SP adds extra communication overhead for attention.
advanced_en.codePath: core/parallel/ → tensor parallel + sequence parallel layer wrapping
